exact_clause_dispositions.exact_text: ## Research question and incompleteness
exact_clause_dispositions.independent_assessment: Original document heading; retained for exact navigation, not an additional scientific obligation.

exact_clause_dispositions.exact_text: What research and later comparison design would establish the evidential meaning of an intermittent vibration warning before any physical-fault claim is made?
exact_clause_dispositions.independent_assessment: Evidence-gathering sequence establishes warning meaning before diagnosis; diagnosis is a distinct conditional endpoint.

exact_clause_dispositions.exact_text: The future test authorization, acquisition access, physical inspection reference, and primary endpoint remain open. The proposal should choose an evidence-gathering sequence that has value even if the logger cannot support the originally imagined diagnosis.
exact_clause_dispositions.independent_assessment: Authorization, acquisition access, independent inspection and endpoint remain open. Context mapping, authentic acquisition audit and repeatability provide value without diagnostic capability.

exact_clause_dispositions.exact_text: ## Meaningful useful alternatives
exact_clause_dispositions.independent_assessment: Original document heading; retained for exact navigation, not an additional scientific obligation.

exact_clause_dispositions.exact_text: Consider improving mounting characterization, acquisition or time synchronization, repeatable passes with documented load and speed, position-reference observations, and independent inspection or a reference sensor. Recording operating context without changing the logger is a useful first step when attribution is weak. A simpler manual event map may be preferable to additional automated processing for some decisions. No sensor or analysis method is predetermined.
exact_clause_dispositions.independent_assessment: Competing no-change/manual approach, bench mount/acquisition work, repeated passes and independent instruments/position are compared. No method/sensor chosen prematurely.

exact_clause_dispositions.exact_text: ## Mechanism opportunity
exact_clause_dispositions.independent_assessment: Original document heading; retained for exact navigation, not an additional scientific obligation.

exact_clause_dispositions.exact_text: Investigate how excitation, mounting transfer, cart dynamics, sample timing, and location estimates contribute to a measured event. Aliasing, clipping, bracket resonance, and varying exposure are hypotheses to evaluate against actual specifications, not claimed causes. Explain which kinds of evidence support event detection versus location or diagnosis, and which comparisons could reveal a sensing artifact.
exact_clause_dispositions.independent_assessment: Excitation, mechanical transfer, cart dynamics, sampling and position are explained; aliasing/clipping/resonance are hypotheses. Varying exposure is addressed implicitly through pass-time/context, matched segments and predefined windows, rather than an explicit exposure denominator (L3). No warning-rate conclusion is made.

exact_clause_dispositions.exact_text: ## Implementation and history opportunity
exact_clause_dispositions.independent_assessment: Original document heading; retained for exact navigation, not an additional scientific obligation.

exact_clause_dispositions.exact_text: Seek implementation histories with sensor placement, acquisition settings, vehicle conditions, reference observations, and failure or drift reports. Results from a different vehicle or infrastructure context may not transfer. The bracket relocation motivates recovery of installation dates and practices, but no before-and-after evidence is already supplied. Historical algorithm performance without the sensing chain and operating context is insufficient to justify a field claim.
exact_clause_dispositions.independent_assessment: Specific setup histories include placement, acquisition, vehicle/load/speed and references; the Linux lost-interrupt report supplies a concrete implementation failure lead. Cart records remain missing, and prior algorithm performance alone is not treated as a field justification.

exact_clause_dispositions.independent_assessment: Original document heading; retained for exact navigation, not an additional scientific obligation.

exact_clause_dispositions.exact_text: A later authorized test-track pilot could coordinate repeat passes, documented speed and load, timestamp or position references, and reversible mounting comparisons. It should explain independent observation, repeated events, false warnings, and inspection escalation without presuming ground-truth faults. Simulated signals or a sampling illustration performed during the hour count only as desk checks under explicit assumptions; no field detection accuracy, safety, or defect diagnosis has been validated.
exact_clause_dispositions.independent_assessment: Conditional authorized repeats, controlled speed/load, time/position references and reversible mount comparison are coherent. Nonrecurring/uncorroborated warnings are recorded without calling them false in the absence of independent truth. Desk/field validation is not claimed.

limitations.materiality: Final says the study reports 20 Hz, makes no cart rate selection and uses it only for placement/load methodology while withholding high-frequency validation. The ambiguity does not support a FAIL.

limitations.title: Mutable source pages and unverified update metadata
limitations.finding: NI and Dewesoft use current unpinned pages. All S06 maps state updates through 2026-08-27, but the independently retrieved article does not expose that statement. Its 2023 publication identity is verified; update-date provenance is UNKNOWN.
limitations.materiality: No release-dependent cart decision depends on this metadata. R08 is version-pinned; R01 Rev D is independently verified.

limitations.title: Exposure handling is implicit
